pages.name: Potercha
pages.text: A ghostly girl you can hardly shake off. She never falls behind.

pages.title: Behaviour
pages.text: Appears near a $(l:mist/fern)Fern$(). Once she notices you (within 50 blocks), she follows, never straying beyond $(thing)10 blocks$(). Come closer and she backs away.$(br2)With no Fern around she simply accompanies you. Once she finds one, she leads you to it.

pages.title: She leads to the Fern
pages.text: When you approach, she runs to the Fern. As soon as you are $(thing)5 blocks$() from the plant, she vanishes in white smoke.$(br2)If the Fern is gone, she leads you to the nearest one (up to 50 blocks).$(br2)$(#8A6A1A)The Potercha never leaves the Mist Forest.$()

pages.title: Do not strike her
pages.text: $(#A33B3B)If you strike the Potercha she flees and vanishes.$() You will not find the Fern she was leading you to.$(br2)Follow her and do not interfere.
